class.name: OcgTopodsShape
class.brief_description: Describes a shape which - references an underlying shape with the potential to be given a location and an orientation - has a location for the underlying shape, giving its placement in the local coordinate system - has an orientation for the underlying shape, in terms of its geometry (as opposed to orientation in relation to other shapes). Note: A Shape is empty if it references an underlying shape which has an empty list of shapes.
class.description: ! Describes a shape which ! - references an underlying shape with the potential ! to be given a location and an orientation ! - has a location for the underlying shape, giving its ! placement in the local coordinate system ! - has an orientation for the underlying shape, in ! terms of its geometry (as opposed to orientation in ! relation to other shapes). ! Note: A Shape is empty if it references an underlying ! shape which has an empty list of shapes.

method.name: TopoDS_Shape
method.description: Creates a NULL Shape referring to nothing.

method.name: IsNull
method.description: Returns true if this shape is null. In other words, it references no underlying shape with the potential to be given a location and an orientation.

method.name: Nullify
method.description: Destroys the reference to the underlying shape stored in this shape. As a result, this shape becomes null.

method.name: Location_1
method.description: Returns the shape local coordinate system.

method.name: Location_2
method.description: Sets the shape local coordinate system.

method.name: Located
method.description: Returns a shape similar to <me> with the local coordinate system set to <Loc>.

method.name: Orientation_1
method.description: Returns the shape orientation.

method.name: Orientation_2
method.description: Sets the shape orientation.

method.name: Oriented
method.description: Returns a shape similar to <me> with the orientation set to <Or>.

method.name: TShape_1
method.description: Returns a handle to the actual shape implementation.

method.name: ShapeType
method.description: Returns the value of the TopAbs_ShapeEnum enumeration that corresponds to this shape, for example VERTEX, EDGE, and so on. Exceptions Standard_NullObject if this shape is null.

method.name: Free_1
method.description: Returns the free flag.

method.name: Free_2
method.description: Sets the free flag.

method.name: Locked_1
method.description: Returns the locked flag.

method.name: Locked_2
method.description: Sets the locked flag.

method.name: Modified_1
method.description: Returns the modification flag.

method.name: Modified_2
method.description: Sets the modification flag.

method.name: Checked_1
method.description: Returns the checked flag.

method.name: Checked_2
method.description: Sets the checked flag.

method.name: Orientable_1
method.description: Returns the orientability flag.

method.name: Orientable_2
method.description: Sets the orientability flag.

method.name: Closed_1
method.description: Returns the closedness flag.

method.name: Closed_2
method.description: Sets the closedness flag.

method.name: Infinite_1
method.description: Returns the infinity flag.

method.name: Infinite_2
method.description: Sets the infinity flag.

method.name: Convex_1
method.description: Returns the convexness flag.

method.name: Convex_2
method.description: Sets the convexness flag.

method.name: Move
method.description: Multiplies the Shape location by thePosition.

method.name: Moved
method.description: Returns a shape similar to <me> with a location multiplied by thePosition.

method.name: Reverse
method.description: Reverses the orientation, using the Reverse method from the TopAbs package.

method.name: Reversed
method.description: Returns a shape similar to <me> with the orientation reversed, using the Reverse method from the TopAbs package.

method.name: Complement
method.description: Complements the orientation, using the Complement method from the TopAbs package.

method.name: Complemented
method.description: Returns a shape similar to <me> with the orientation complemented, using the Complement method from the TopAbs package.

method.name: Compose
method.description: Updates the Shape Orientation by composition with theOrient, using the Compose method from the TopAbs package.

method.name: Composed
method.description: Returns a shape similar to <me> with the orientation composed with theOrient, using the Compose method from the TopAbs package.

method.name: NbChildren
method.description: Returns the number of direct sub-shapes (children).

method.name: IsPartner
method.description: Returns True if two shapes are partners, i.e. if they share the same TShape. Locations and Orientations may differ.

method.name: IsSame
method.description: Returns True if two shapes are same, i.e. if they share the same TShape with the same Locations. Orientations may differ.

method.name: IsEqual
method.description: Returns True if two shapes are equal, i.e. if they share the same TShape with the same Locations and Orientations.

method.name: IsNotEqual
method.description: Negation of the IsEqual method.

method.name: EmptyCopy
method.description: Replace <me> by a new Shape with the same Orientation and Location and a new TShape with the same geometry and no sub-shapes.

method.name: EmptyCopied
method.description: Returns a new Shape with the same Orientation and Location and a new TShape with the same geometry and no sub-shapes.

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream
